instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the correct spelling of the word.

atoms.b: I ((++can kan cane)) meet you any time after 5:00 pm.
atoms.finishSound: I can meet you any time after 5 pm.

atoms.b: Please take the ((++cap capp kap)) off the bottle.
atoms.finishSound: Please take the cap off the bottle.

atoms.b: The mother polar bear walks with her ((++cub kub cube)) over the ice.
atoms.finishSound: The mother polar bear walks with her cub over the ice.

atoms.b: You may choose a ((++cup cap kupp)) from the shelf for your tea.
atoms.finishSound: You may choose a cup from the shelf for your tea.
